meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Yahoo: consent frame, ad blocks and newsletter card, plus story thumbnail, top stories and side rail controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of yahoo.com (desktop UA and iPhone UA 390x844) and news.yahoo.com (desktop), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM (later re-fetching failed on a resource-starved machine). Fixtures real.html (phone Home), desktop-real.html (desktop Home) and desktop-news.html are structural captures with text stripped. Yahoo is a Tailwind/Next.js site: utility classes are unusable, so the rules use `id`, `aria-label` and the readable `cls-` layout classes.

LIVE counts (phone Home / desktop Home / desktop news): `#privacy-banner-container` 1/1/1 (an empty host for the consent frame, nothing visible in the capture), `.ad-container` 7/8/8, `[id^="taboola-stream"]` 5/5/0, newsletter `li:has(form[aria-label="Newsletter sign up form"])` 0/0/1, `.cls-card-story img` 45/45/0, `section[aria-label="Top stories"]` 1/1/1 (15 slides on desktop Home), `#stacked-list` 0/1/0, `#right-rail` 0/1/0, `li.cls-module-Shopping` 1/1/0, `li.cls-module-TrendingVideo` 0/1/0.

The Top stories label is English-only, so that rule and the newsletter rule match nothing in other editions. The `cls-` classes are layout classes Yahoo can rename. The existing `ads` and `cookie-banners` options gained the Yahoo rules above; the other original generic rules matched nothing here. NOT verified: logged-in Yahoo Mail, Finance and Sports sub-sites, the visible consent dialog (it renders in a frame and was empty), regional editions.
